meta.title: NAM - Not a Machines | Boutique Product Lab - namlab.io
meta.description: Global boutique product lab. We rescue stalled products, launch new ones, and teach teams to build with soul - human intelligence first, AI as amplifier.

hero.subtitle: We are NAM - a global boutique product lab. An international cross-functional team that rescues stalled products, validates new ideas, and teaches teams to think like product strategists - with human intelligence first and AI as an amplifier, never a replacement.

cards.title: Startup founders & idea holders
cards.body: You have an idea and the courage to build it - but no map. We validate your concept with a clear Go / Pivot / Kill verdict, shape the business model, and define what to build first so you spend money on learning, not guessing.

cards.title: Small businesses
cards.body: Your business works offline or in early digital form, and you feel the market shifting. We help you design your first digital product, price it right, and launch without burning the budget on features nobody asked for.

cards.title: Medium businesses
cards.body: The team is in place, processes run - but the product has flatlined. Revenue plateau, feature fatigue, founder bottleneck. We diagnose why growth stopped at the product level and design the way out - together with your team, not instead of it.

cards.title: Products that need a rescue or redesign
cards.body: Your product or service brings revenue but has lost its edge - outdated experience, unclear positioning, AI confusion. We run a full product autopsy, rebuild the strategy, and give your product its next chapter.

services.title: What we do
services.intro: Three pillars. One philosophy: human intelligence first, AI as amplifier.
services.disclaimer: Final scope defined after a discovery call.

probono.title: Pro Bono for Defenders
probono.body: We take on product cases of veterans of the Russian-Ukrainian war completely free of charge. Same team. Same process. Same quality. Zero cost. You defended the future - we will help you build it. If you are a veteran with a product idea or an existing business that needs product expertise, apply below.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.manifesto: We are Not a Machines. We use machines to be more human.
principles: AI amplifies judgment, never replaces it. AI gives data - people give meaning.
The 80/20 rule. AI handles 80% of routine; strategy, empathy and creative breakthroughs remain exclusively human territory.
AI-washing detection. We help clients spot where AI adds real value versus where it is just marketing.
Meaningful integration test. Does it improve the end-user experience? Can a human do it better? Does it add meaning - or just automation?

members.name: Nataliia M.
members.bio: 10+ years leading products across B2B, B2C and B2B2C in five regions. Former CPO with certified expertise in SAFe Product Ownership, Six Sigma Black Belt and IBM Enterprise Design Thinking. Specializes in product diagnostics, business model design, GTM strategy and Web3 ecosystems. Believes every product deserves an honest verdict before a beautiful roadmap.

members.name: Alex K.
members.bio: Product designer with a decade of experience turning complex services into interfaces people actually enjoy. Expert in UX research, design systems, accessibility-first design and rapid prototyping. Leads NAM's design diagnostics inside every Product Rescue Sprint - because most "growth problems" hide in experience debt.

members.name: Marko D.
members.bio: Engineering leader with hands-on experience scaling platforms from MVP to millions of users. Deep expertise in system architecture, technical due diligence, AI integration strategy and build-vs-buy decisions. Translates business ambition into technical reality - and tells founders the truth about what their stack can and cannot do.

members.name: Iryna S.
members.bio: Growth strategist specializing in positioning, content ecosystems and community-led growth for B2B services. Runs NAM's media pillar - podcast, newsletter and social presence - and designs GTM engines for client engagements. Obsessed with one question: why should anyone care?
